set(SDL_SHARED ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_STATIC ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_TEST_LIBRARY OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(SDL)

set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GLFW_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GLFW_BUILD_TESTS OFF ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GLFW_BUILD_DOCS OFF ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GLFW_INSTALL OFF ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(glfw)

include(glad.cmake)
include(glm.cmake)
include(libpng.cmake)

add_subdirectory(miniaudio)
